_doc: Lumi's base stats before upgrades. plant_growth / seed_yield: garden-wide multipliers on plant growth speed and seeds per bloom (research raises them: the ~1 h garden ramp, docs/BALANCE.md). [pace] Slow start: small chest, slow scoop; baler_unlocked / lift_class / signal_finder come from the Baler, Lift Strength and Signal Finder upgrades. [v4bots] hover_water: Hover Jets (owner item 54): without them Lumi stops at the shore. scoop.bite_vol: units of waste one scoop pulse lifts before Scoop Size (stat pickup_count multiplies it); Lumi's hand rate is bite_vol x pickup_count x scoop_rate units a second, 4.9 at the start before aiming losses (the accepted proposal's 4 a second). move_speed: 5 m/s (was 4.6): the walk between the junk and the bin is the slowest part of the first minutes (owner, Nov 10). carry_stack: bales Lumi carries at once. cube: what a pressed bale pays against the same load tipped loose, by press quality: plain_mult (under good_from full, or overstuffed), good_mult (at least good_from full), perfect_mult (inside perfect_band). Every one is above dump.mult: tipping never beats pressing (design spec section 16.7). dump: a loose load tipped in the bin pays mult x its worth (its share of the hexes it came from, core/hex_worth.gd); after_baler: whether the bin still takes loose loads once the Baler is fitted; radius_m: how close to the bin Lumi tips. magnet: the Magnet Arm pulls at most pull_base + pull_per_level x its level loose pieces at a time (nearest first; never a piece seated in a heap or too heavy for Lift Strength), at pull_speed m/s, until they are stop_m from the scoop. old_save_grant: levels added to saves from before the slow start.
